{\footnotesize Marks: $^{s}$ single source; $^{w}$ widened to the error of the method; $^{t}$ cut at zero; $^{a}$ analog of the unmeasured quantity, run beside the main case; $^{\dagger}$ sensitivity case only, never decides a result; $^{d}$ design axis; $^{c}$ convention; $^{I}$ ionic-strength flag. Grades: A direct measurement with uncertainty under the conditions of the study; B direct, other conditions or no uncertainty; C derived, fitted or compiled; D abstract only.\par}
